track.notes: Open: the vote picked the 4th above Segah's finalis (about 240 Hz). The finalis pitch (about 178.8 / 357.6 Hz) is never played here; the nearest established pitch is about 345 Hz, 63 cents below it, so it is left as voted. Check by ear.
